description: APPLICATION FOR THE RETENTION OF  LINK BUILDING ATTACHED TO REAR EXTENSION.
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="font-size:13.0pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12.0pt;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">The
height and cumulative massing of the retained link, extending to approximately
2.8 metres along a substantial portion of the garden, would appear visually
overbearing and unduly dominant when viewed from the adjoining properties at
Nos. 148 and 152 London Road. Unlike the detached outbuilding accepted at
appeal, the addition of the link creates an excessive sense of enclosure and
materially harms neighbouring outlook. The proposal therefore fails to
safeguard neighbouring amenity, contrary to Policy D12.1 of the Merton Local
Plan.</span></p>
